labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Rich already supports header-less tables via Table(show_header=False), documented in docs/source/tables.rst; usage question.

items.body:
Rich already supports this: set `show_header=False` on the `Table` and the header row and its separator are not rendered. See the [tables docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst) and the `show_header` parameter in [`rich/table.py`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/table.py).

If that does not match what you see, please share a short runnable example and the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`. For general usage questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.
